scene: You glide out of the star shuttle into the glittering Planetarium Dome.
picture: Flat side-view along a level tiled floor under projected stars. On the far left stands a brass mechanical orrery. Beside it, the silver star shuttle door stands open. In the centre, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair. Right sits an empty velvet lounger, and far right sits a glowing console.
shown: a giant clockwork model of revolving planets standing on the far left
an empty plush purple reclining seat positioned to the right
a star projector console with illuminated buttons on the far right

variants.scene: Constellations shimmer across the giant glass ceiling as you roll onto the deck.
A sea of pixel stars glows above, reminding you of {tune}.
Starlight washes over the observatory floor just outside your shuttle's warm ramp.
